# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class PermanentPortfolioAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    _drift_threshold = 0.01

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        self.settings.seed_initial_prices = True
        
        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        for ticker, weight in [("SPY", 0.6), ("TLT", 0.4)]:
            symbol = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.MINUTE).symbol
            portfolio = self.add_portfolio_member(symbol).portfolio
            portfolio.target_weight = weight
            # Warm up the portfolio target weight through manual warm-up since automatic_indicator_warm_up
            # only supports automatic indicators and not manual indicators.
            self.warm_up_portfolio_target_weight(symbol, weight)
            portfolio.drift_threshold = self._drift_threshold

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_quarter(),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open("SPY", 1),
            self._rebalance
        )

    def on_warmup_finished(self) -> None:
        self._rebalance

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        for portfolio in self.portfolio.values():
            if not portfolio.target_weight:
                continue
            current_weight = portfolio.holdings.value / self.portfolio.total_holdings_value
            if abs(current_weight - portfolio.target_weight) > portfolio.drift_threshold:
                self.set_holdings(portfolio.symbol, portfolio.target_weight)
                break
